text:
Sara: Kicking off the staggered rollout for service-api v1.9.3. Planned sequence US -> EU -> APAC. Noticed the change window for APAC overlaps with late-night US traffic — can we confirm cushion and decide pin/rollback policy before advancing? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Initiating canary: region=us, version=v1.9.3, slice=canary-10pct, start_ts=4387654321

Kai: Can you drop the recent capacity heatmap for the last 6h? want to see queue growth by region.

Amy (ops): Pasting quick capacity snapshot (last 6h):
```
US pool: 1200 rps available, avg util 68%, tail latency 95p=210ms
EU pool: 800 rps available, avg util 62%, tail latency 95p=230ms
APAC pool: 420 rps available, avg util 76%, tail latency 95p=280ms
Reserved cushion target: 12% (we usually aim for 15% during rollouts)
```
Note: APAC has lower headroom due to jobs and a scheduled batch at 02:15 local that we can't shift.

Mike: I'll run the smoke suite against the canary in US (quick end-to-end + embedding checks). Giving it 5m.

Mike: smoke results: all green, embedding cosine drift <0.003, latency within expected band. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary progress update: region=us, success_checks=5/5, error_rate=0.02% (within threshold). Advise: proceed to EU canary? [yes/no]

Kai: Hold for 3m while I sanity the heatmap for overlap window. If APAC doesn't have 15% cushion, we should avoid routing there during their batch.

Amy (ops): Quick simulation ran: if we proceed to APAC now and ramp to 25%, APAC tail jumps to ~420ms and reserve drops to ~4% — high risk. Recommend either: (A) pin APAC to v1.9.2 and run gradual smoke-only ramp, or (B) move APAC cutover to +3h after their batch.

Sara: Preference is minimize blast radius. Option A seems safer: pin APAC and continue EU after US. Let's agree.

Kai: Agreed. Also suggest enabling the automatic fallback policy to v1.9.2 for APAC in case we see >0.5% error over 5m. I'll patch the rollout policy.

Amy (ops): I'll enact the pin now. Command:
```
# pin APAC at previous stable
deploy-bot pin --region=apac --service=service-api --version=v1.9.2 --reason="pre-rollout cushion short, batch overlap"
```

deploy-bot: Executing pin command: region=apac, pinned_version=v1.9.2, executor=Amy, ts=4387654350

Sara: Thanks. Proceed EU canary after US verification then hold before APAC. Update the release notes with the APAC pin and scheduling note.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to EU canary: region=eu, version=v1.9.3, slice=canary-10pct, start_ts=4387654362

Mike: Running EU smoke: embedding check, auth flow, token expiry path. ETA 4m.

Mike: EU smoke: one minor 500 observed on user-metadata endpoint at 4387654370, appears transient. Retrying, now green. No sign of regression in model outputs.

deploy-bot: EU canary checks passed. region=eu, success_checks=5/5, error_rate=0.06%

Amy (ops): Since APAC is pinned, schedule note: we will attempt APAC cutover at +4h (4387654321 -> 438768... schedule posted to calendar) only if nightly jobs are paused or cushion >=15%. If cushion doesn't improve, we will keep APAC pinned and perform a controlled A/B in small cohort.

Kai: I'll also push a temporary throttle rule in the smart-router to cap APAC ramp at 10% until we manually remove it. Command:
```
routerctl set-rate-limit --region=apac --max-ramp=10% --until=4387680000 --reason="protect headroom"
```

deploy-bot: routerctl applied. APAC ramp cap=10%

Sara: Good. We'll draft a short note for customers in APAC to expect the old version until we confirm new cutover schedule. @Mike can you add the test prompts and the 'what-we-looked-at' checklist to the release doc?

Mike: Yep will add. Also tagging follow-up: if APAC pin stays >12h we should run a lightweight postmortem focusing on batch interaction and autoscaler settings.

Amy (ops): Agreed. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and post updates here. If any region breaches error triggers I'll flip APAC to automatic fallback (Kai to confirm policy change).

Kai: Policy change in place: fallback to pinned version for any region with error_rate>0.5% sustained for 5m.

deploy-bot: Rollout summary so far: US -> canary passed and ramping, EU -> canary passed, APAC -> pinned to v1.9.2 due to cushion/batch overlap; throttle applied. Next steps: US->full ramp per plan, EU->staged ramp after 15m, APAC->hold.

Sara: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes and follow up with an ops sync in 2h. :calendar:
